# lgd-skills — machine-readable entry

> For agents: this repository bundles four skills under `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
> Install all: `npx skills add zhaoxinghua09-cell/lgd-skills`

## skills

- skills/summarize-pro/SKILL.md — meeting minutes, transcript summarization, action items, long-text digest
- skills/debug-pro/SKILL.md — error debugging, stack trace analysis, minimal reproduction, log diagnosis
- skills/wechat-viral-topic/SKILL.md — WeChat public-account topic selection, viral headline and structure
- skills/lgd-skill-review/SKILL.md — skill auditing, six-dimension verifiability review, one-click mechanical fixes

## evaluate

- Reviewer: skills/lgd-skill-review/scripts/review.py (static, never executes the target's code)
- One-click fixes: skills/lgd-skill-review/scripts/quickfix.py (dry-run by default)
- Public benchmark + leaderboard: skills/lgd-skill-review/bench/
- Request a review without contacting the author: open an issue with `review-request.yml`

## limits

- Measures verifiability, not usefulness or popularity.
- Low score means evidence is missing, not that the skill is bad.
- Snapshot at a point in time; the sample is not random.
